decision.section: Iterate - feature: gate catalog unattended answers and autonomy plumbing
decision.title: Opt-in unattended_answer per gate; unattended behaves as autonomous
decision.context: A Brief-package run needs to finish with nobody present, but the catalog could not say which stops may be answered automatically, autonomy knew only guided and autonomous, and test and changelog had no cataloged gates.
decision.decision: Optional reviewed unattended_answer on exactly three design gates; validate_catalog rejects it on denylisted, locked, hard-stop and non-orchestrator-approve gates (lib/gate_unattended.py, denylist pinned by test). The resolver only reports it under unattended; the master applies it. test and changelog join COVERED_PHASES. Every autonomy consumer treats unattended as autonomous.
decision.consequences: Adding an auto-approvable gate needs an explicit catalog line plus the pin test change. The phase-gate override still refuses unattended (no human). Application of the answer (hash and FR-coverage checks, flag off) lands in campaign U3.
decision.rationale: The catalog is already the reviewed SSoT with a validator; one optional key plus one rule is the smallest change that keeps locked gates unreachable.
decision.rejected: A second catalog file (second source of policy); hard-coding the three gates in the master (unvalidated); resolver unblocking the gate itself (bypasses the master checks).

changelog.bullet: Gate catalog: autonomy unattended with reviewed per-gate answers (three design approvals), denylist and validator rules, test and changelog gates, and unattended accepted wherever autonomous is

behaviors.behavior: exactly design.preview-approval, design.review-loop-finalize and design.upload-screen-mapping carry an unattended_answer
denylist pinned by id (11 ids + out-of-sequence-continue / prereqs-missing families) and every id exists in the catalog
validate_catalog rejects unattended_answer on denylisted, constitution-locked, hard-stop, auto-default and blank/non-string entries
resolver reports the answer only under autonomy unattended, never changes should_stop, fails closed on an unvalidated ineligible gate, inert outside a run
unreadable, absent or non-string run_config autonomy never reads as unattended; CLI --autonomy overrides run_config
write-config accepts guided/autonomous/unattended, rejects a typo; schema enum names unattended and supervised
test and changelog phases cataloged (COVERED_PHASES tuple and JSON together), each phase skill carries its gate-discipline block, gate_catalog.md in sync
D6 prose consumers (run/build/test/changelog/deploy prompts, constitution tables, guide) read unattended as autonomous
behaviors.reason: prompt text read by an agent; live proof is campaign unit B7's real end-to-end run

finalize.reason: iterate: gate catalog unattended answers and autonomy plumbing
